sql:
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        sub.league_id,
        sub.team_long_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sub.home_team_goal > sub.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
        SUM(CASE WHEN sub.away_team_goal > sub.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_wins
    FROM (
        SELECT m.league_id, t.team_long_name, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
        FROM Match m
        JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT m.league_id, t.team_long_name, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
        FROM Match m
        JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    ) sub
    GROUP BY sub.league_id, sub.team_long_name
)
SELECT 
    l.name as league_name,
    tw.team_long_name,
    CAST(tw.total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON l.id = tw.league_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins, tw.team_long_name) = 1
ORDER BY l.name

WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        sub.league_id,
        sub.team_long_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sub.home_team_goal > sub.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
        SUM(CASE WHEN sub.away_team_goal > sub.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_wins
    FROM (
        SELECT m.league_id, t.team_long_name, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
        FROM Match m
        JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT m.league_id, t.team_long_name, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
        FROM Match m
        JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    ) sub
    GROUP BY sub.league_id, sub.team_long_name
)
SELECT league_id, team_long_name, total_wins FROM team_wins WHERE total_wins = 0
